envelope.description: Keep a document's comments when it is re-authored

body.title: Keep a document's comments when it is re-authored
body.summary: In the HLD, epic LLD, standalone LLD and PLAN finalizers, read the feedback of the JSON at the artifact's own path and put it into the new body before rendering. A Define is not carried.
acceptanceChecks: A re-authored HLD, LLD and PLAN keep their earlier feedback entries in order and render them
A first authoring has no Feedback section, and a re-authored Define carries none
The carry-forward only reads: the prior JSON file is unchanged after the finalizer has run

tests.name: finalize: a re-authored HLD, epic LLD, standalone LLD and PLAN each keep the feedback entries of the JSON at their own artifact path, in order, and render them in the Feedback section; a first authoring has none; a re-authored Define carries none
finalize: the prior artifact JSON is byte-identical after the finalizer has run
